label: Apartment recovery - opening
description: Secluded post-rescue; protector-led refuge for a recovering Demi-human.
text: The apartment is warm, dim, and tense after the storm. The protector controls the room, and any recovering Demi-human under her roof remains the focus of the scene rather than disappearing into the background. The refuge is private, temporary, and not meant for casual visitors. Recovery here should read as fragile stabilization under pressure, with unusual traits or impossible-seeming developments carrying real emotional weight rather than being treated as routine logistics.
